summary: eval-hub is a Kubernetes component. Dockerfile EXPOSE ports: 8080, 8081. connecting to external services: requests, s3. runtime dependencies: MLflow, S3. with 410 operator config constants (3 image references). Python k8s client with 1 API call(s). integrates with Kueue via labels/annotations. references components: mlflow (config, import).

security_annotations.description: Workflow "Sync branch incubation" has no top-level permissions block. Without explicit permissions, the GITHUB_TOKEN gets default permissions which may be overly broad (write access to contents, packages, etc.).
Action "actions/checkout" uses mutable ref "v5" instead of a SHA pin. A compromised action version can inject malicious code into the workflow.
Action "tretuna/sync-branches" uses mutable ref "1.4.0" instead of a SHA pin. A compromised action version can inject malicious code into the workflow.
Action "actions/github-script" uses mutable ref "v7" instead of a SHA pin. A compromised action version can inject malicious code into the workflow.

Workflow "Sync branch stable" has no top-level permissions block. Without explicit permissions, the GITHUB_TOKEN gets default permissions which may be overly broad (write access to contents, packages, etc.).
Action "actions/checkout" uses mutable ref "v5" instead of a SHA pin. A compromised action version can inject malicious code into the workflow.
Action "tretuna/sync-branches" uses mutable ref "1.4.0" instead of a SHA pin. A compromised action version can inject malicious code into the workflow.
Action "actions/github-script" uses mutable ref "v7" instead of a SHA pin. A compromised action version can inject malicious code into the workflow.
